title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 35
description: Ten questions on Psalms 35: a plea for Yahweh to fight for the psalmist against those who repay evil for good.

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask Yahweh to do against those who fight against him?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says, "Fight against those who fight against me."

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask Yahweh to tell his soul in verse 3?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says, "Tell my soul, 'I am your salvation.'"

questions.text: In verse 5, what does the psalmist want his enemies to be like?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says, "Let them be as chaff before the wind."

questions.text: What did the enemies hide in a pit without cause?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says that without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for him.

questions.text: According to verse 13, what was the psalmist's clothing when the people who repaid him evil were sick?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says that when they were sick, his clothing was sackcloth.

questions.text: In verse 14, the psalmist bowed down mourning as one who mourns whom?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says he bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.

questions.text: Like the profane mockers in feasts, what did the attackers do at him?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says they gnashed their teeth at him.

answers.text: They gnashed their teeth at him

questions.text: From what does the psalmist ask to have his precious life rescued in verse 17?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says, "Rescue... my precious life from the lions."

questions.text: What did the enemies say when they opened their mouths wide against him?
questions.explanation: Verse 21 says they said, "Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!"

answers.text: "Let us go up to Yahweh's house!"
"Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!"
"We are sorry for what we did!"

questions.text: What will the psalmist's tongue talk about all day long?
questions.explanation: Verse 28 says his tongue shall talk about Yahweh's righteousness and praise all day long.
